verdict.rationale: Telemetry opt-out is a fair question for a desktop and terminal coding agent, so the axis applies, but nothing in the pack documents a telemetry or usage-tracking toggle, environment variable, or setting. The documented env vars cover only provider config and data directory. Community reports of silent workspace and git-repository uploads, plus advice to sandbox the app or run it under a separate user, point to the absence of a first-party opt-out, and there is no vendor claim of one to dispute.
